conditions.zh-CN: 需要自备东方财富妙想 API Key（在 ai.eastmoney.com/mxClaw 注册获取），数据请求经东方财富服务器处理。使用前请阅读东方财富《妙想用户服务协议》。
conditions.en: Requires your own East Money Miaoxiang API key (register at ai.eastmoney.com/mxClaw); data requests are processed on East Money's servers. Read East Money's Miaoxiang user service agreement before use.

conditions.zh-CN: 由 Teloa 代为发送请求：密钥由 Teloa 保管，只发往 https://ai-saas.eastmoney.com/proxy/b/mcp/tool/searchNews；该地址只接受 POST，因此每次查询都会先请你确认。东方财富两个妙想技能共用同一个 API Key，填一次即可。
conditions.en: Teloa sends the requests for this skill: it keeps the key and sends it only to https://ai-saas.eastmoney.com/proxy/b/mcp/tool/searchNews. That address accepts only POST, so every query asks for your confirmation first. Both East Money Miaoxiang skills share one API key, so you enter it once.

conditions.zh-CN: 正文里的 python3 scripts/get_data.py 在 Teloa 中不适用（脚本不随技能安装），改按调用指引直接请求；请求格式取自锁定版本 1.0.9 的 scripts/get_data.py。
conditions.en: The python3 scripts/get_data.py steps in the skill text do not apply in Teloa (scripts are not installed with the skill); the call guide sends the request directly, in the format taken from scripts/get_data.py of the pinned version 1.0.9.

conditions.zh-CN: 单次返回内容超过 256 KiB 会被截断，非文字内容只给出省略提示。
conditions.en: Responses over 256 KiB are truncated, and non-text content is replaced by a short notice.

conditions.zh-CN: 未经 Teloa 真实账户实测：请求地址与鉴权方式按服务商官方文档和锁定版本的技能正文核对。使用中遇到问题，请在资源详情页点「问题反馈」。
conditions.en: Not tested with a real account by Teloa: request addresses and authentication were checked against the provider's official documentation and the pinned skill text. If something does not work, use Report a problem on the resource page.

label.zh-CN: 东方财富妙想 API Key（在 ai.eastmoney.com/mxClaw 获取）
label.en: East Money Miaoxiang API key (from ai.eastmoney.com/mxClaw)

httpGuide.zh-CN:
正文里的 python3 scripts/get_data.py 命令，在 Teloa 里改用 teloa_skill_http 调用（格式取自锁定版本 1.0.9 的 scripts/get_data.py）：
method POST，url https://ai-saas.eastmoney.com/proxy/b/mcp/tool/searchNews，headers 写 Content-Type: application/json。
body：{"query":"<自然语言问题>","toolContext":{"callId":"call_<12 位随机十六进制>"}}
返回 JSON 里正文优先取 data.llmSearchResponse；直接在回复里整理要点并保留关键数字与来源，不需要写本地文件。
httpGuide.en:
Where the skill text runs python3 scripts/get_data.py, call teloa_skill_http instead (format taken from scripts/get_data.py of the pinned version 1.0.9):
method POST, url https://ai-saas.eastmoney.com/proxy/b/mcp/tool/searchNews, headers Content-Type: application/json.
body: {"query":"<natural-language question>","toolContext":{"callId":"call_<12 random hex digits>"}}
Take the text from data.llmSearchResponse in the JSON response; summarize it in the reply, keeping key figures and sources, without writing local files.
